questions: goal: approve these goals? G-1 adds that release PRs merge through the door; G-2 retargets from 1.2.0 to the first cut after 3.0.1 (4.0.0 if a sweep commit carries !, else 3.0.2), with each later fix released within two days; new G-3 model choice in every WUWEI repository (record model and effort on every launch, outcomes by model after 14 days, due 2026-11-08); new G-4 the 2026-10-18 feature backlog shipped or ruled on within a 3,400-line runtime budget (due 2026-11-30). Recommendation: Approve.

plan: approve this plan? 35 items on 4 goals, about 68 build hours (1 size point = 1 h); the plan is shown above. It includes budget-3400 (runtime limit 3,000 to 3,400 lines, config keys 5 to 6; backlog estimate 3,384 at item budgets), the bug sweep first, the models-table and models-record items, three close items (#1078, #1098, #999), four spikes, and two release cuts. Recommendation: Approve.

trust: should a CI job post a required wuwei/gates commit status from the evidence it reads on the wuwei/state branch (#918)? Any session that can push wuwei/state can shape that evidence, so the status holds authors outside WUWEI but is not proof against a session. Recommendation: Yes, as a tripwire for authors outside the plugin.

scope: should the watch pass read alerts from an alerting MCP you connect (Sentry, PagerDuty, Datadog) and turn them into lead candidates by severity (#415)? Recommendation: Yes, as skill text only: the skill reads, the lead ranks, nothing is filed or paged automatically.
